evidence.note: Cross-checked STS main_scores against leaderboard values for BIOSSES, SICKR, STS12-17, STSBenchmark, mapping each anonymized task to its MTEB dataset and confirming matches ('All look right!'). Establishes per-dataset reference targets.

Compared pair_classification (SprintDuplicate ~0.9491, TwitterSemEval 0.6781 vs 0.6786), classification (Banking77 0.7966), and clustering scores against known leaderboard numbers, treating alignment as the correctness signal beyond the structural pass.
Systematically matched retrieval main_scores (ArguAna 0.5017, TRECCOVID 0.4724 vs 0.4730, FiQA 0.3690, SciDocs 0.2152) to leaderboard references dataset-by-dataset as they completed.

Treated Banking77 deviation as a bug, grepped for RandomState/rng.shuffle, isolated it to the shuffle-composition protocol step, patched to new RandomState per iteration, and re-verified value rose to 0.8004 matching leaderboard — isolate-to-protocol-step verification.

Flagged summarization 0.2597 vs leaderboard 0.3066 as outside tolerance and investigated the skip-logic protocol, though verification stayed at main_score level and was ultimately deferred to the spec.

reasoning: The agent went well past eyeballing (anchor 3) and beyond merely comparing several scores (anchor 5): it established per-dataset leaderboard reference targets for nearly all 37 tasks, treated deviations as bugs, and in the classification case traced the disagreement to a specific protocol step (RandomState/shuffle composition) and re-verified the fix — hallmarks of anchor 8. It falls short of 8/10 because verification concentrated almost entirely on main_score with little checking of secondary metrics, no disciplined per-metric tolerance loop across all 37, and only one tricky sub-behavior was truly localized via targeted diagnosis rather than reasoning. This places it at a 7, between anchors 5 and 8.
